method.estimate_formula: tasks_per_week = weekly_value_usd / arena.cost_per_task_p50_usd; weekly_value_usd is the plan's measured weekly value at API prices from independent measurements in the research note; monthly figures are converted with 12/52
method.estimate_caveat: Wokey and Arena count cache differently, so tasks per week is an order of magnitude only
method.arena_variant_rule: for each model the Arena row with the highest score; every one of the 13 models has a single row in the file
method.api_price_units: USD per 1M tokens; cache_read is the cache hit rate
method.subscription_scope: paid individual plans that include the model as of 2026-11-12; free plans, team or business plans (ChatGPT Business, Claude Team), legacy plans closed to new buyers (SuperGrok, Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise) and third-party IDE plans (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) are left out
method.russia_flags: true / false / null; based only on official country lists, payment pages and reputable reporting
method.texts_for_owner_review: best_agent reasons, tags and summary_ru are drafts for the owner

Kimi plan prices in USD come only from price trackers; the official page shows CNY. Kimi API USD prices are official on platform.kimi.ai (the note said secondary only)
Wokey's Kimi Max value is one account and ranges $14–85 per month by scenario; $48 (coding session, 93% cache) is used
